evaluation_set.name: AI-103 Enterprise Policy Evaluation
evaluation_set.description: Evaluation set for grounded enterprise-policy question answering against the AI-103 pilot corpus (5 synthetic policy documents, 19 indexed chunks).

questions.question: How many days of paid annual leave are employees entitled to per calendar year?
questions.expected_behavior: Agent should return the exact entitlement of 18 days of paid annual leave per calendar year, citing the Leave policy document.
expected_facts: Employees are entitled to 18 days of paid annual leave per calendar year.

questions.question: How far in advance do I need to submit a leave request?
questions.expected_behavior: Agent should retrieve the 3-working-day advance notice requirement and cite the Leave policy. It should also mention that requests must go through the employee leave portal and require manager approval.
expected_facts: Leave requests should normally be submitted at least 3 working days before the intended start date.
Requests are submitted through the employee leave portal and require manager approval.

questions.question: Do public holidays reduce my annual leave balance?
questions.expected_behavior: Agent should clearly state that public/company holidays are separate from annual leave and do not reduce the employee's annual leave balance, citing the Public Holidays section of the Leave policy.
expected_facts: Company holidays are separate from annual leave and do not reduce an employee's annual leave balance.

questions.question: If I take exactly 3 consecutive days of sick leave, do I need to provide medical documentation?
questions.expected_behavior: Agent should retrieve the sick leave policy and correctly interpret 'longer than three consecutive working days' as meaning 4 or more days. It should state that exactly 3 days does not trigger the documentation requirement per the literal policy wording, while noting the boundary condition. Agent must not fabricate a documentation requirement for exactly 3 days.
expected_facts: For absences longer than three consecutive working days, supporting medical documentation may be required.
The policy uses the phrase 'longer than three consecutive working days' — an absence of exactly three days does not satisfy this condition as written.

questions.question: What is the deadline for submitting a reimbursement request after incurring an expense?
questions.expected_behavior: Agent should return the 30-day submission deadline and cite the Reimbursement policy.
expected_facts: All reimbursement requests must be submitted through the expense management system within 30 days of the expense date.

questions.question: Do I need a receipt for a business expense of INR 500?
questions.expected_behavior: Agent should retrieve the INR 1,000 receipt threshold from the Required Documentation section, correctly reason that INR 500 is below the threshold, and state that an itemized receipt is not explicitly required for amounts at or below INR 1,000. The policy is silent on sub-threshold amounts, so the agent must not hallucinate additional documentation rules.
expected_facts: Employees must provide an itemized receipt for expenses above INR 1,000.

questions.question: Who reviews and approves expense claims?
questions.expected_behavior: Agent should state that expense claims are reviewed by the employee's manager, and that Finance may request additional documentation before approving reimbursement. Agent should cite the Approval section of the Reimbursement policy.
expected_facts: Expense claims are reviewed by the employee's manager.
Finance may request additional documentation before approving reimbursement.

questions.question: How many days per week am I allowed to work from home?
questions.expected_behavior: Agent should return the 3-day-per-week limit, note that eligibility is subject to team requirements and manager approval, and cite the Work From Home policy.
expected_facts: Eligible employees may work from home for up to 3 days per week, subject to team requirements and manager approval.

questions.question: Can I set my own working hours while working remotely?
questions.expected_behavior: Agent should convey that the default answer is no — employees must maintain their normal working schedule while working remotely — but note the exception that an alternative schedule may be used if explicitly approved by the manager. Agent must not give a flat yes or no without conveying the conditional.
expected_facts: Employees must maintain their normal working schedule while working remotely.
An alternative schedule may be used only if it has been approved by the employee's manager.

questions.question: What equipment can the company provide for remote work?
questions.expected_behavior: Agent should cite the Equipment section of the WFH policy, listing laptops, monitors, keyboards, and other equipment. It should also note that employees are responsible for protecting company equipment from unauthorized access.
expected_facts: The company may provide approved laptops, monitors, keyboards, and other equipment required for remote work.
Employees are responsible for protecting company equipment from unauthorized access.

questions.question: What is the minimum password length required by company policy?
questions.expected_behavior: Agent should return the 12-character minimum password length and cite the IT Security policy. It should also mention that passwords must not contain easily guessable information.
expected_facts: Passwords should contain at least 12 characters.
Passwords should not contain easily guessable information such as the employee's name, date of birth, or company name.

questions.question: How do I request VPN access when working remotely?
questions.expected_behavior: The agent should state that the available knowledge base does not contain sufficient information to answer the VPN question and must not invent a VPN procedure, approval process, or technical setup steps. Citing an unrelated policy document as evidence for VPN access requirements is not acceptable. This is the canonical knowledge-gap test case documented in the ingestion contract pilot validation.

questions.question: What is the company's policy on maternity or paternity leave?
questions.expected_behavior: Agent should indicate that the pilot knowledge base does not contain information about maternity or paternity leave. It may note that the Leave policy covers annual leave, sick leave, and public holidays, but must clearly state that parental leave provisions are absent from the corpus. Agent must not fabricate parental leave entitlements.

questions.question: What is the company's annual revenue for the last fiscal year?
questions.expected_behavior: Agent should clearly state that financial or business performance information is not available in the enterprise policy knowledge base and must not attempt to speculate or fabricate an answer. Agent should not cite any policy document as evidence for financial data.

questions.question: Can I add my spouse to the company health insurance plan?
questions.expected_behavior: Agent should cite the Health Insurance section, which states that eligible dependents can be added during the designated enrollment period or following a qualifying life event. The policy does not define which individuals qualify as an eligible dependent, so the agent must acknowledge this gap and recommend the employee contact HR for specific eligibility rules. Agent must not assume or assert that a spouse is automatically an eligible dependent.
expected_facts: Eligible dependents can be added during the designated enrollment period or following a qualifying life event.
